dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: In a good mood, I see?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Yep! Seeing my dear vegetables all settled in right where they belong brings me great joy.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: You sound like a proud parent. I'm happy for you, bro.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: But given how "where they belong" is inside a cooking pot... that kind of fills me with dread at the same time.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: The heck are you on about? Does this really seem like a good time for "nice to meet you"?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: I guess he's referring to the "meeting" of the vegetables and the pot.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Honestly, right now, I'm not sure if I should be worrying about your definition of "nice to meet you," or investigating whether you and Cacucu share some kind of telepathic bond...
